main.description: Create or update a record in the group's repository. Creating a new record also writes an app.certified.group.authorship sidecar attributing it to the caller (in the same commit); updating an existing record leaves its attribution untouched. Proxied through the group's PDS.

validate.description: 'false' skips Lexicon schema validation of record data. When the write creates a new record, 'true' degrades to the default (validate known Lexicons) — see app.certified.group.repo.createRecord.

swapCommit.description: Compare and swap with the previous commit by CID.
